WITH step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) as avg_price,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) as avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
step6 AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    AVG(avg_price) as avg_of_price_avgs,
    AVG(avg_cost_ratio) as avg_of_ratio_avgs
  FROM step5
  GROUP BY town_city
),
step7 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_of_ratio_avgs) as overall_avg_ratio
  FROM step6
)
SELECT 
  step6.town_city,
  step6.avg_of_price_avgs,
  step6.avg_of_ratio_avgs,
  step6.avg_of_ratio_avgs - step7.overall_avg_ratio
FROM step6
CROSS JOIN step7
WHERE step6.avg_of_ratio_avgs > step7.overall_avg_ratio
ORDER BY step6.town_city
